    MAX(p.standard_attr_id) - MIN(p.standard_attr_id) AS range_standard_attr_id,
    VARIANCE(p.standard_attr_id) AS variance_standard_attr_id
FROM ml2_port_bindings AS mpb
INNER JOIN ports AS p ON mpb.port_id = p.id

    SELECT 1
